sloka: ततस्ते दैवतगणा निवृत्ता रणकर्मणः ।तच्छ्रुत्वा रावणेर्वाक्यं स्वस्थचेताः बभूव ह ।। ७.२९.३८ ॥
transliteration: tataste daivatagaṇā nivṛttā raṇakarmaṇaḥ ।tacchrutvā rāvaṇervākyaṁ svasthacetāḥ babhūva ha ।। 7.29.38 ॥

translations.english: Then, having heard that speech of Indrajit, those hosts of gods ceased from the act of battle and indeed became composed.
